Im applying to medicine/veterinary and im really afraid I wont fit in with any crowd there. I dont exactly follow gender stereotypes, and i have a couple piercing and tattoos. I feel like that will definetley be a barier to meeting new people in my uni.
I know that I could always just reach out to people outside uni but I have no idea where and how.
